name: STACK Infrastructure Perth PER01 campus (Wangara)
notes: STACK Infrastructure's first Perth campus at 92 Windsor Rd, Wangara (City of Wanneroo LGA, light-industrial suburb ~20km north of Perth CBD; Wikipedia confirms Wangara is in City of Wanneroo). Two buildings PER01A (8MW) and PER01B (16MW) for 24MW total campus capacity on ~2.2ha; Western Power 22kV N+1 supply, N+1 block-redundant UPS/generators, 48h fuel storage, carriers Optus/Vocus/TPG/Telstra. Announced via official STACK press release Jun 2022 as part of a 124MW Australia entry (Melbourne/Canberra/Perth); official PER01 campus brochure dated Mar 2023. Status: Baxtel lists 'planned'/future facility; some directories (e.g. dcatlas.io) list 24MW as operational - no Wanneroo council DA record located in web searches, so status and capacity remain only partially verified. capacity_mw is ultimate campus capacity, not IT load.
